name: Petrochemicals Research & Innovation Commendation
benefit:
- The scheme provides a citation and a memento for each award category.
- Travel Allowance and Dearness Allowance will be provided to the awardees for attending the presentation function in person.
- The scheme provides national and international recognition to innovations, helping to improve the performance and quality of products leading to better market acceptance.
- Historically, under the pre
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an Indian citizen, institution, industry, organisation, or Start-up registered in India. - The applicant must be an entity created by the Central government, State governments, or Union Territories. - The applicant must limit the maximum number of members to five, in case of applying as a team or group. - The applicant must present an innovation that is an original product, process, or an improvement on an existing product or process. - The applicant must ensure the innovation increases the utility of the product or process by enhancing consumer advantages, accuracy, reliability, safety, product life, or versatility. - The applicant must not submit a mere theoretical hypothesis, an innovation simply in the idea stage, or a perpetual motion machine. - The applicant must present an innovation that is not older than three years at the time of submitting the application. - The applicant must not be an awardee of previous editions of the National Petrochemicals Awards for the immediate three preceding editions or years.
